# CrowdSpark Full Product Specification & System Documentation

## Executive Overview
CrowdSpark is an all-in-one interactive assessment, live polling, and educational gamification platform designed for the modern web. The platform bridges the gap between active presentations and audience understanding by turning traditional one-way talks into interactive, competitive, and data-driven experiences.

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite, Lucide Icons, Vanilla Modern CSS Design System, Responsive Mobile-First Architecture.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express REST API, Socket.io Real-Time Synchronization Engine.
- **Database**: MongoDB with Mongoose ODM (Quizzes, Questions, Session History, User Accounts, OTP verifications, Analytics).
- **Authentication**: JWT (JSON Web Tokens), Google OAuth 2.0, Secure Password Hashing with bcrypt, ZeptoMail / SMTP OTP Verification.
- **AI Engine**: Integrated Large Language Model API for instant question generation with schema enforcement.

## Product Modules & Workflow

### 1. Host Dashboard & Quiz Creator
- **Manual Creation**: Custom questions, customizable multiple-choice answers, time limits (10s to 90s), point values.
- **AI Generator**: Enter any subject prompt (e.g. "Quantum Computing Basics", "World War II Timeline", "JavaScript Promises"), choose difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard), and the engine constructs questions with 4 distractor options and answer validation.
- **Quiz Library**: Hosts can edit, clone, delete, search, and launch any saved quiz into a live room.

### 2. Live Game Engine
- **Lobby**: Generates unique 6-digit numeric game PIN and animated QR code. Displays connected players with avatars in real time.
- **Question Screen**: Synchronized countdown timer, media-rich question display, answer option grid with color coding.
- **Live Aggregation**: Real-time bar chart showing participant answer distribution before revealing the correct answer.
- **Leaderboard**: Top 5 podium calculation with streak bonuses and rank progression animations.

### 3. Participant Client
- **Lightweight Web App**: Zero friction login. Compatible with Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Edge on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, ChromeOS, Linux.
- **Interactive UI**: Big clickable color-coded answer pads corresponding to the host display screen.

### 4. Post-Session Analytics
- Host receives aggregate accuracy percentages, toughest questions identified, player rankings, and downloadable CSV/Excel export files.
